cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll stay through this hard conversation. Someday I need you equally open with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Not points. A place where both of us can be unsteady.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know if I can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say that honestly. It's a first payment.

mechanism: A sets the terms and approves installments of reciprocal vulnerability as repayment for emotional support.
confusable: Unlike comforting freely, A demands equivalent future exposure; unlike arithmetic alone, the payment is actual personal risk.
comparison: Private support after a job loss and a first confession differ from matching a public family admission in a.
seedUse: Retain the seed's concern about scorekeeping and first-payment admission, grounding the hard conversation and giving S01 authority over terms.
